web.title: Ramadan Calendar 2026
web.description:
# Ramadan Calendar 2026
## **When will Ramadan 2026 start?**
This year, most Muslims marked the beginning of the holy month of **Ramadan on the evening of Tuesday 17 February.**

## **When will Ramadan 2026 end?**
### **Frequently Asked Questions**
This year, Ramadan is expected to begin on **Tuesday 17 February 2026, and will end on the evening of Wednesday, March 18, with the exact dates contingent upon the sighting of the moon.**

web.title: Ramadan 2026: When Does Ramadan Begin and End?
web.description:
# Ramadan 2026: When is Ramadan? What is Ramadan?
## Caption
This year, the holy month of Ramadan begins at the first sighting of the crescent Moon on the evening of Tuesday, February 17, 2026.

## When Is Ramadan?
| Year | First Evening of Ramadan (fasting begins at dawn next day) | Final Evening of Ramadan (Eid al-Fitr) |
|-|-|-|
| 2026 | Tuesday, February 17 | Wednesday, March 18 |
| 2027 | Sunday, February 7 | Monday, March 8 |
| 2028 | Thursday, January 27 | Friday, February 25 |
| 2029 | Monday, January 15 | Tuesday, February 13 |

## Catherine Boeckmann
